message:
feat(ka-pc r1): the managed standby viewer runs end to end; "returning" until the Host can have ended a session

Run and fixed (8936b0b was built, not run):
- every way out of a session closes its window and drains its messages (run_session): a session ended by
  --seconds, the host or a takeover used to leave a window whose context was gone (the re-entry probe's
  second session read a stale quit and ended at once);
- after an activation's session, the lease says "returning" for 12 s before "ready": the Host ends a
  session only after 10 s of a silent control channel and until then a Release is Live and a re-admission
  Busy; a Pong is not the grant coming back (Codex model A). A tap while returning still activates
  (the shell allows it); the page shows "돌아오는 중";
- the activation's log line says "activation ok", not "hello ok";
- the shell gives a Host that did not confirm standby one more try 60 s later, then none (Codex: an
  unanswered standby Hello is "not confirmed", not proof of an old Host).

Tests (isolated: loopback, test server.js, a test Host; the viewer window beyond the virtual screen; all
files under REMOTE60_TEST_TMP; GPU slot taken with CreateNew and released):
- ka_pc_managed_e2e: 53/0 x3 -- standby ready with no window/decoder; Activate -> product picker
  (WGC capture) -> desktop pressed -> first picture (WGC capture) -> Park -> returning -> the SAME lease
  ready again (no new directory capability) x2; activations only (no ordinary Hello, Host sessions all by
  activation); another device using the Host undisturbed by standby, the tap takes over; owner-epoch
  fence; Release accepted by the Host; the shell's ManagedViewers module (launch, events, EndAll at
  once, child ends in the bound, older owner's events dropped); job close ends the child; the published
  0.2.163 Host: unsupported, no ordinary Hello, no session. FINDING (measured, reported, not counted):
  a new lease of the same device started right after a crash got no answer and ended "unsupported" (x3).
- ka_pc_reentry_probe: two sessions in one viewer process, both connect and present, x3.
- units 20/20; punch_any, session_client, candidates, op_gate, standby lease/entry client PASS.
- GNLinkViewer.exe (product): no test seam strings; GNLinkViewerKaTest only.

Product: viewer (run_session, managed standby), shell (tap while returning, reprobe), shell.html.
Tests: e2e. Docs: report.
